reviewMethod: Official-provider documentation checked. All new sources DOCUMENTATION_ONLY; zero current endpoint health checks or authenticated keys verified; camera permissions not inferred from catalogues.
rule: Every observation requires source id, acquisition UTC, temporal/spatial uncertainty, provenance, per-data use rights and independent validation. A PUBLIC_CATALOG is NOT a live video license.

sources.spatialAccuracy: ~2 km at nadir; degrades toward limb
sources.timing: CONUS ~5 min; full disk ~10 min; check each product
sources.use: strict mask 10/11/30/31; FRP quality per mask
sources.gap: Must independently check individual acquisitions/hash/angle; GOES-19 is GOES-East since 2025-04-07; no operational alert certification.

sources.spatialAccuracy: 375 m nominal; not a fire perimeter
sources.timing: satellite overpass; NRT lag can be hours outside US/Canada
sources.use: independent hotspot corroboration and archive
sources.gap: Credible no-go for life/property emergency decision using unverified hotspot alone.

sources.spatialAccuracy: perimeter accuracy varies by agency and incident
sources.timing: service may refresh frequently but geometry observation time differs
sources.use: independent event/perimeter history, link incident ID and valid timestamp
sources.gap: Not every fire has perimeter; refresh time must not equal mapping time.

sources.timing: forecast issue_time and valid_time are different
sources.use: wind, gust, temp, RH with uncertainty and forecast lead
sources.gap: Forecast is not a ground measurement; archive reanalysis vs operational replay must be separated.

sources.spatialAccuracy: danger index forecast around 8–10 km; burned-area mapping distinct
sources.timing: forecast time layer TIME; fire perimeter after sensor acquisition
sources.use: European danger baseline, historical fire and mapped damage
sources.gap: FWI is weather-based fire danger, not speed or fire location; apply attribution and layer terms.

sources.timing: product-dependent
sources.use: European geostationary FRP with product and quality flags
sources.gap: Research per-product API, calibration & licence; not a blanket thermal stream.

sources.timing: dataset states images every >= 3 minutes; continuity not guaranteed
sources.use: aggregated counts after verification of exact feed terms
sources.gap: Don't equate 900 listed camera objects with 900 stream licences; no radiometric temperature.

sources.spatialAccuracy: road camera homography required for speed
sources.timing: location and camera health metadata vs live image are different
sources.use: camera discovery/status and link to operator
sources.gap: CC BY catalogue does not automatically establish rights to redistribute HLS frames; ask Caltrans.

sources.timing: real-time and archived, use measurement timestamps
sources.use: independent quantitative road speed/flow labels for camera validation
sources.gap: Registration is required; can't claim integrated.

sources.timing: dataset says approx hourly camera location update; not image frame cadence
sources.use: ES camera geolocation and road condition feeds as separate products
sources.gap: DGT location records are not a live public CCTV stream.

sources.spatialAccuracy: pan/tilt and georeferencing must be calibrated per frame
sources.timing: camera/provider-dependent
sources.use: smoke early warning research candidate
sources.gap: Public visualization does not prove bulk automated machine ingestion rights; no thermal temperature without sensor specs.

sources.spatialAccuracy: image smoke boxes, not fire perimeter
sources.timing: offline labelled dataset
sources.use: benchmark smoke classifier, disjoint by camera, fire event and geography
sources.gap: Avoid train/test leakage from same camera. Dataset release versions differ.

sources.spatialAccuracy: ~1 km pixel, not flame temperature or perimeter
sources.timing: NRT latency less than 3 h for specified product; verify actual granule timestamps
sources.use: independent polar-orbit FRP corroboration for European and global cases
sources.gap: NRT product/version/nighttime limitations and rights; true flame-front speed requires perimeter cross-validation.

sources.timing: 10 min MTG demo; product availability depends on region and status
sources.use: European heat emission and time-resolved fire product candidate
sources.gap: MTFRPPIXEL demonstration only; scientific and operational review incomplete; data-server registration required.

sources.spatialAccuracy: 100 m native thermal bands, frequently resampled to 30 m grid
sources.timing: orbital repeat and cloud gaps; NOT continuous emergency camera
sources.use: historical burn/thermal surface context, independent land radiance
sources.gap: Sensor saturation, emissivity and atmospheric correction; not flame temperature and cannot provide continuous real-time front.

sources.timing: DATEX2 v3.6 introduced; v2.3 traffic measurements phased out 2027-02-09
sources.use: Prefer accurate loop measurements, roadside safety and roadworks; NOT CCTV images
sources.gap: GZIP and DATEX XML; parse 3.6; check provider licence and feed's UTC, station status and measured-at

sources.timing: 100000+ measurement locations; not all public to unaffiliated third parties
sources.use: Backtesting road closures and evacuation traffic hypotheses
sources.gap: Access via NDW partner organization; cannot infer license to redistribute IVP or floating-car vehicle traces

sources.timing: Current JSON TMS and standardized DATEX II; cache one minute
sources.use: Independent speed and volume calibration; 5-min sensor counts
sources.gap: API measurement time vs response time; missing quality, stale detector and source station inventory

sources.timing: Road weather observations minute cadence; weather camera assets separate
sources.use: Cross-validate fog/smoke/precipitation or road camera blindness
sources.gap: A weather observation is not a wildfire detector; no image inference without licence and asset validation

sources.timing: Conventional station observations, lightning map and fire danger map
sources.use: Calibrate local wind/moisture and baseline fire-danger index
sources.gap: Index of danger is NOT fire speed nor observed flame temperature; access key not stored in repo

sources.timing: Measurements with validation status code, time in UTC
sources.use: Time aligned ground wind and humidity with historic fire front
sources.gap: Observations can describe a previous 30-min interval; do not use a future interval for a past alert

sources.timing: Image URL and location listed, described ~3 min periodicity; last catalogue update 2019
sources.use: Licensed camera health plus smoke and traffic count calibration candidate
sources.gap: 2019 catalog date; image URL validity and video reuse require fresh endpoint check

sources.timing: EDR space-time archives and MQTTS warning feed
sources.use: Authority-sourced hazard context, trigger after signature and issuer trust check
sources.gap: Hub/submit reserved for member meteorological services; public website != token rights

sources.timing: Aerosol optical depth / PM forecast; product/version specific
sources.use: Disambiguate haze/smoke via external aerosol forecast with time-issue checks
sources.gap: Modeled aerosol forecast, not a direct camera measurement or ground observed visibility
